name: Junlin Gonghe - Diguo Xiaoyequ
source:
The winter wind swept across the platform as Alexander stood outside the station, his brows slightly furrowed. Archer—once the kingdom’s sharpest hunter—was now his sole personal guard and closest companion. Together, they boarded the train bound for the Japanese islands, ready to enjoy a well-deserved vacation.

[From [url=https://thunderrangers.itch.io/imperialserenade]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
冬日的风席卷着月台，亚历山大站在车站外，眉头微皱。阿切尔——曾经是王国最敏锐的猎人——现在是他唯一的私人卫士和最亲密的伙伴。他们一起登上了开往日本列岛的火车，准备享受一个当之无愧的假期。

[来自[url=https://thunderrangers.itch.io/imperialserenade]Itch.io[/url]]
